metadata.name: Sediment‑core 210Pb & 137Cs depth profile – LSMo22‑1 (2022‑04‑08)
metadata.description: Depth‑resolved measurements of total, supported, and unsupported 210Pb and 137Cs activities (Bq kg⁻¹) from a single sediment core (event LSMo22‑1) collected at latitude 21.365278 N, longitude -104.568333 W, elevation 750 m on 2022‑04‑08. The dataset contains 29 depth intervals ranging from 0.0 m to 0.285 m with a uniform spacing of 0.005 m, and includes analytical uncertainties for each radionuclide measurement.
